overview: The Medford City Council met to address citywide parking enforcement, permit parking rules, traffic speed concerns, and cemetery policies. The Council also approved a financial transfer related to Magoon Park and discussed delays in public meetings on the Cradock Bridge project.

items.title: Sidewalk Parking Enforcement Update
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting an update from the police chief on sidewalk parking citations and calling for stepped-up citywide enforcement.

items.title: Graffiti and Trash Clean-up at Bigelow Building
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution calling on the owner of the Bigelow building to remove graffiti and resolve dumpster trash issues.

items.title: Traffic Enforcement on Mystic Valley Parkway and Local Streets
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting state and local police increase enforcement against illegal turns and speeding on Mystic Valley Parkway, Auburn Street, and several neighboring roads.

items.title: Republic Parking Report and Permit Parking Policies
items.summary: The Council requested an annual report and meeting with Republic Parking and passed a motion extending 2015 Marion Street permit validity through 2016.

items.title: Birthday Congratulations to Former Councilor Robert Drennan
items.summary: The Council voted to extend official birthday wishes to former City Councilor Robert Drennan for his 93rd birthday.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Advisory Board and Green Burials
items.summary: Following a resident presentation on Oak Grove Cemetery, the Council referred questions regarding green burial options and creating a cemetery advisory board to the city solicitor.

items.title: Magoon Park Project Fund Return
items.summary: The Council voted to return $201,064.07 from grant reimbursements and unexpended funds for the Magoon Park project back to the sale of real estate account.

items.title: Cradock Bridge Construction Meeting Update
items.summary: Councilors discussed scheduling delays for a meeting with MassDOT regarding Cradock Bridge construction impacts and voted to request a copy of the city's agreement with MassDOT.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records from January 19, 2016.
